Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase after a slight delay. The New Zealand players make their way out to the playing field. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers will open the innings for West Indies. Trent Boult has the new ball in his hand. There is a slight drizzle around but we are ready to go..
... The Run Chase ...
UPDATE 3.38 am IST (10.08 pm GMT, the previous day) - There is some good news! The weather has gotten better but there is a slight drizzle. The umpires though have decided to get on with the play.

UPDATE 3.33 am IST (10.03 pm GMT, the previous day) - The live scenes from the ground depict the covers are on. There has been a bit of rain and it is gloomy out there. The umpires are currently out in the middle and hopefully, it is only a short delay. Stick around for further updates.

Right then, we shall take a short break and return for West Indies' reply. They have a strong batting lineup but lack consistency and West Indies will hope that they are able to get them over the finish line. New Zealand have gone into the game with just two frontline spinners, unlike their opponents who had three. There is assistance for the bowlers and they will be hoping to put on a disciplined performance. They need early wickets if they are to have a chance in this game. Do join us soon.

Yannic Cariah comes up for a chat and he says that it is a great feeling as he worked hard for years to reach here and it feels good. Adds that when he came on to bowl, he tried to express himself and he is grateful that it came off. Says that the wicket will get better and praises Akeal Hosein for the way he bowled. Ends by saying that he is confident that the batters will chase it down and the key is to put pressure on the bowlers from the get-go.

The hosts will be most pleased with the way the bowlers have executed their plans today. This has been one of the most complete bowling performances we have seen from the Windies in the recent past. The fast bowlers, at the start of the innings, were unable to get wickets but the introduction of spinners towards the end of the first Powerplay completely turned the game in the favor of the West Indies. They kept pegging away at the wickets with Akeal Hosein clearly the pick of the bowlers taking 3 wickets and conceding just 28 runs in his full quota of 10 overs. Kevin Sinclair and Yannic Cariah, both got a wicket on their ODI debut and did really well to keep it tight to not let New Zealand break the shackles. The fast bowlers did well to wrap up the tail with Alzarri Joseph picking up 3 wickets and Jason Holder chipping in with two. Now it is up to the batters to go and chase a target of under 200 thereby taking a lead in this series.

New Zealand started off well with a 41-run opening partnership but lost both their openers in quick succession. The scoring dropped drastically after the West Indies brought on their spinners into the attack. The skipper Kane Williamson hung around for a bit but kept losing his partners at the other end. When he was dismissed, New Zealand were six down for the score of 122 on the board. The lower order chipped in with a few runs to push their total close to the 200 mark. New Zealand will be really disappointed that many of them got off to a steady start but none of them could capitalize on it. In the end, it will be a tough task for the bowlers to defend this target.

The visitors have not been able to play out their 50 overs! What a bowling performance from West Indies here. They have absolutely dominated an established batting lineup with two debutants in their bowling ranks. The decision to stack their team heavily with spinners has worked for the Windies. The pitch has done wonders for the slower bowlers as they have stifled New Zealand and restricted them to an under-par score of 190.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! That is it for the New Zealand innings as they have been bowled out with 28 balls still to go. Alzarri Joseph bowls this on a length and outside off, Trent Boult looks to make room by going to the leg side but he moves a bit too far away from the ball. He tries to poke at the ball from there but only manages to get an inside edge onto the stumps. New Zealand finish on 190 runs here.
This is banged short and on middle, Trent Boult looks for the upper cut but cannot connect.
Alzarri Joseph is brought back into the attack.
A slower bumper now, over leg stump. Lockie Ferguson tries to fend it away but gets himself in an awkward position and misses the ball completely.

Sharp bouncer! This is banged short and on middle and leg, Lockie Ferguson goes for the pull taking his eyes off the ball. He misses and it goes towards the keeper where he grabs it and appeals for the catch but the umpires says no. Nicholas Pooran, however goes for the review but UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved and the decision remains NOT OUT.
No hat-trick for Holder. This is slower, on a length and on off, Trent Boult pushes it towards point for one and gets off the mark.
Trent Boult is the last man in for New Zealand. Also, Jason Holder is on a hat-trick now.

OUT! TIMBER! Jason Holder is on a hat-trick here! Holder goes full and pace on now, angling it into leg stump. Tim Southee moves a long way across the off stump as he attempts the scoop. The ball sneaks under his willow and goes on to shatter the leg stump. This is a good comeback from Holder after receiving a bit of stick early in the innings and New Zealand are just one wicket away from getting bundled out.
Lockie Ferguson is the next batsman in for New Zealand.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jason Holder gets himself in the wickets column and Mitchell Santner departs after showing some fight. Slower delivery, bowled into the deck and over middle stump. Santner takes it on but gets it off the top edge. The ball goes high and towards deep mid-wicket where Jermaine Blackwood takes a well-judged catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Jermaine Blackwood b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! The effort was brilliant though! This is full and wide, Tim Southee goes deep in his crease and thumps it towards long on. Shamarh Brooks over there times his jump well and sticks out a right hand to pouch it but drops it before falling over the ropes. Just a single then.
Jason Holder (7-1-37-0) has been brought back into the attack now.
Around middle, Southee forces it off the back foot down the ground for one more. End of a brilliant spell by Akeal Hosein. His figures read, 10-0-28-3!
Flatter delivery, around off, Santner rocks back and plays it past point for a single.
Swing and a miss! This is fired in around off stump. Mitchell Santner looks to dispatch at it downtown but completely misses the ball.
This is darted in at the pads, Santner tickles it towards backward square leg.
Quicker delivery, turning into the pads, Santner goes on the back foot and keeps it out.
Hosein comes from over the wicket and angles it in, on a shorter length and from around off. Santner backs away and taps it towards covers.
Akeal Hosein comes back into the attack for his final over. His figures so far reads as (9-0-26-3).
Length, around middle and this is pushed back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up again, full and around middle. Tim Southee gets underneath it and plays a lofted drive right back over the bowler's head to pick up a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle, Santner shimmies down the track, turns it into a full toss and works it down to long on for just a run.
Full, on middle and leg and this is heaved away towards wide long on for a single.
Flighted, around off, Santner eases it towards covers and picks up a run.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for Mitchell Santner but he won't mind. This is tossed up around off, Santner dances down the track and looks to loft it but gets beaten in the flight. The ball goes off the inside edge and past leg stump, running away into the fine leg fence.
Back of a length and slanted across the batter. Santner hangs back and pulls it well in front of mid-wicket for a single.
In the air but safe! This is banged in short and over middle, Tim Southee looks to take it on but gets a top edge that flies down fine towards third man. Just a single is taken.
Pace off and into the pitch, around off and the ball keeps a bit low. Santner adjusts well and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length again and around off, Santner rocks back and flat-bats it past the man at mid on for a cracking boundary.
Back of a length, angling across the left-hander. Santner lets it through to the keeper.
Holder comes back into the attack and starts off with a short ball outside off. Mitchell Santner tries to take it on but misses.
Floated, full and on leg stump, Tim Southee keeps it out.
Drops it a bit short, Santner goes on the back foot and punches it through covers for one.
Beaten! This is bowled quicker and closer to the off pole, Mitchell Santner looks to cut but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Flatter delivery, around off and cut away through point for one.

An absolute ripper! This is served on a nagging length, on off stump and just skidding through. Tim Southee gets pushed onto the back foot and gets beaten past the outside edge as the ball also goes agonizingly over the off stump.
Nicely tossed up, around off, Tim Southee lofts it over extra cover and picks up a couple of runs.

The umpire signals the start of Powerplay 3 which means that the bowling team can now have up to five fielders outside the 30-yard circle. Also, the drizzle is fairly consistent but the players are continuing at the moment.
Flights this one up and around off, Tim Southee goes for the block but gets a thin outside edge past the keeper and towards short third man. They cross.
Flatter and on off again, turning in a bit, Tim Southee leaves his stumps but manages to hit it towards point.
Slower through the air and on off, turning in, Tom Latham makes room and guides it towards backward point.
Quicker one, full and on middle, Tim Southee stays there and blocks it to the legs side.
Goes a bit short now and outside off, Mitchell Santner goes on his back foot and cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Floated full and on off, Mitchell Santner knocks it towards covers.
A googly now, on off, turning in, Tim Southee leans on to play at it but decides against it at the last moment. End of a successful over.
Flatter delivery, short and around off, Tim Southee stays back and pushes it towards covers.
Tim Southee comes to the crease and there is a light drizzle at the moment as well. Quite handy with the bat and will be looking to play a cameo here.

OUT! LBW! Plumb in front! Yannic Cariah gets the breakthrough for his side and picks up his maiden ODI wicket. This is nicely tossed up, on off stump and turning into the left-hander. Michael Bracewell tries to defend off the front foot but gets beaten by the turn and gets pinged on the pads. There is a loud appeal for lbw and the umpire gives it out. Bracewell has a word with his partner and reviews. There is no spike on UltraEdge and its three reds on Ball Tracking which means Bracewell has to walk back.
Floated, full and on middle, Mitchell Santner makes room and punches it past point for one.
A bit short and on middle, Mitchell Santner tucks it away to mid-wicket.
Good leave! This is pushed through quicker and on off, turning in, Mitchell Santner leaves it alone.
Flights this one up and around off, Michael Bracewell guides it towards point.
Tossed up and on off, Michael Bracewell leans on and blocks it to covers.
Floated and around leg, Michael Bracewell looks to work it to the leg side but gets an inside edge towards short leg.
A bit short and on middle, Michael Bracewell this time tucks it away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Tossed up, full and on middle, angling in. Michael Bracewell looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a slight appeal for LBW but turned down.
Slower through the air and on off, turning away, Michael Bracewell guides it towards point wiht the outer half.
Quicker through the air and on middle, turning in , Mitchell Santner gets cramped but manages to block it to the off side.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is again a bit short and on off, Mitchell Santner goes on his back foot and crunches it wide of the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up, short and on off, Mitchell Santner pushes it towards point.
Much better this time. Yannic Cariah floats this up and around off, Michael Bracewell slaps it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! A poor delivery and punished. This is short again and on middle, Michael Bracewell hangs back and pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Starts with a short delivery and on middle, turning in, Mitchell Santner makes room and guides it with a opened face towards deep point for a single.
Yannic Cariah (5-0-23-0) is brought back into the attack.
This is shorter in length and outside off, Michael Bracewell goes for the cut over point but gets an inside edge onto the ground.
A good-length delivery and on off again, Michael Bracewell knocks it towards covers.
FOUR! Good shot this by Bracewell. Jason Holder bowls this short and on middle, Michael Bracewell gets into position quickly and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Jason Holder again lands this on a good length and outside off, angling away, Mitchell Santner slices it towards third man for a single.
Length again and around off this time, Mitchell Santner stays back and pushes this towards covers.
Serves this on a length and on middle, Mitchell Santner blocks it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Edged and dropped! Then some shoddy fielding into the deep! Kevin Sinclair loops this full outside off and gets the ball to turn off the pitch. Michael Bracewell pushes at the ball and gets an edge that flies between the keeper and the first slip. Kyle Mayers at slip makes a valiant effort diving to his right but only manages to get his fingertips to this. The ball races towards the third man fence and Nicholas Pooran chases after this. He stops the ball and goes over the boundary but collects it while he is still across the boundary line! That will be four runs.
Kevin Sinclair decides to flight this one slower in the air and full outside off, Michael Bracewell defends this back to the bowler.
This one is also fired in short and into the stumps, Mitchell Santner makes room and cuts this to deep point for a single.
Bowls a quicker delivery full and on off, Michael Bracewell works this towards long on for a single.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for New Zealand! Kevin Sinclair floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Michael Bracewell leans forward and works this past the mid on fielder for a boundary to long on.
Kevin Sinclair flights this one full outside off. Defended towards the cover fielder.
Bowls a full delivery in line with stumps, Michael Bracewell works this to square leg and takes a run.
Pulls his length back a fraction and outside the off pole. Mitchell Santner stands tall and punches the ball to deep point for a single.
This one is a fraction full but still outside off stump, Mitchell Santner plays this with soft hands towards short cover,
Jason Holder keeps bowling good length and the outside off stump line. Mitchell Santner knocks this towards covers.
Bowls on a good length once again and outside off, Michael Bracewell guides this to third man for a single.
Jason Holder begins with a good-length delivery served outside off, Michael Bracewell raises his arms and leaves this one alone.

DRINKS! Well, West Indies have got the visitors in a stranglehold at the moment. Their bowlers have been spot on with their lengths and have picked up wickets as well. There was a good stand brewing between Kane Williamson and Daryl Mitchell but Joseph's double-strike has sent both of them back to the pavilion, leaving the Kiwi lower order a lot to do. Can Santner and Bracewell lead some sort of a fightback? Or will the Windies wrap things up in a hurry? Also, Jason Holder comes back into the attack.

Gives a bit of room outside off and bowls this full, Michael Bracewell punches this towards long off and takes a run to keep strike. Just three runs coming from this over. The spinners are keeping it really tight.
A loopy delivery served full and in line with the stumps, Michael Bracewell taps this back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Goes back to bowling short and outside off, Mitchell Santner goes deep in the crease and works the ball towards deep cover to get off the mark with a single.
Flights this one full and on middle, Mitchell Santner defends this to the left of the bowler.
Kevin Sinclair pulls his length back once again and outside off, Michael Bracewell rocks back and plays the ball to deep point for a single.
Kevin Sinclair bowls this a bit short and outside off, Michael Bracewell looks to cut this square but gets beaten.
Two left-handers at the crease and the off-spinner, Kevin Sinclair is brought back into the attack.
Continues bowling full now but outside off this time. Mitchell Santner knocks the ball straight to mid off.
Alzarri Joseph serves this a fraction full and on middle and leg, Michael Bracewell flicks this to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Alzarri Joseph bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps. There is extra bounce from the wicket and the ball takes a leading edge and falls back onto the pitch as Michael Bracewell looks to work this leg side.

FOUR! A lucky one but he won't mind. Joseph bangs this one short and on middle, Michael Bracewell goes for the pull a bit late and gets a top edge over the keeper and the ball races away to the fence.
On a length and on the fifth stump line, Michael Bracewell guides it towards point.
This is on a hard length and on middle and off, Michael Bracewell stays back and blocks it down the pitch.
Flights this one full and angling into the pads, Mitchell Santner gets a stride forward and ushes at it. Gets an inside edge onto his pads. Just one run from the over.
Short once again and angling into the pads, Mitchell Santner clips this towards mid-wicket.
A fraction short and served outside off, Mitchell Santner goes back in the crease and knocks the ball to covers.
Akeal Hosein flights this one full and angling into the stumps, Michael Bracewell shimmies down the wicket and knocks the ball to long on for a single.
This is full and outside off, Michael Bracewell goes back in the crease and looks to defend. The ball catches the bottom end of the bat and almost spins back onto the stumps.
Akeal Hosein bowls this full and angling down leg, Michael Bracewell looks to clip this leg side but misses. Goes past his legs but is not called wide by the umpire.
Mitchell Santner makes his way to the crease. Now it is up to the lower order of New Zealand to take them to safety. Also, Akeal Hosein (8-0-25-3) comes back into the attack now.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! A huge moment in the game as Alzarri Joseph sends the Kiwi skipper packing! Joseph serves this one on a good length, in that channel around off and this one holds its line. There's just a bit of an extra bounce as Kane Williamson has a little nibble at it. The ball takes the outside edge and Shai Hope does the rest behind the sticks. Joseph picks up his 20th ODI wicket at this venue and West Indies are in complete control here.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Around the top of off, defended out on the off side.
WIDE! Some aggression from Alzarri Joseph as he serves a sharp bouncer over middle. The ball though flies over Williamson's head and a wide is called.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Back of a length and around off, Williamson bends his back a bit and uses the pace of the ball to steer it to the right of third man. Akeal Hosein over there lets it through his hands and it will be a boundary. Joseph doesn't look impressed with that effort.
Bracewell is underway right away! Joseph switches to around the wicket for the left-hander and angles in a full ball at the toes. Bracewell works it 'round the corner for a single.
Michael Bracewell has made his way out to the middle. New Zealand still have some work to do here.

OUT! LBW! Alzarri Joseph goes a bit wider of the crease and angles in a length ball from around off stump. Daryl Mitchell shuffles a touch and looks to work it away leg side but misses. Mitchell gets caught on the crease and pinged on the pads and there is a huge shout for lbw from the bowler but the umpire remains unmoved. Nicholas Pooran does eventually opt for the review. The third umpire checks UltraEdge first and finds a flat line on it. Ball Tracking is checked next and well, it comes up with three reds! The steady stand is broken and West Indies have the breakthrough they desired.
Joseph bangs it in halfway down the track and angles it around the batter's helmet. Daryl Mitchell tries to get inside the line and pull but misses.
On off, Williamson defends it off the front foot.
Flatter and around off, turning away, Williamson works it towards the cover region.
Flighted, around middle, Mitchell uses his feet and drives it down to long on for a single.
On a length and on off, blocked out.
FOUR! Well played! On the pads again, Daryl Mitchell gets down on one knee and sweeps it past square to pick up a boundary.
Risky attempt from Daryl Mitchell. This is fuller and angling down the leg side, Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep but the ball goes off his gloves and lobs up, falling just short of the bowler.
Length ball, at 144 clicks and slanted into middle and leg. Williamson defends it out on the off side.
Back of a length and around off, Daryl Mitchell plays it off the back foot and with an angled bat. He gets it to the right of the man at third man and picks up a single.
Around the top of off, this is punched off the back foot and towards cover-point.
Goes a bit fuller now and on a tighter line around off stump, Mitchell makes another leave as the ball dies on its way to the keeper who spills it.
This is banged in short and around off, Mitchell looks to pull but gets taken aback by the extra bounce. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat towards mid off.
A length ball, bowled well outside off and just nipping back in late off the deck. Daryl Mitchell leaves it alone.
Nicholas Pooran is mixing things up here a bit. Brings back Alzarri Joseph (5-0-24-0) into the attack.
This is full and bowled at the toes, Daryl Mitchell goes deep in his crease and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Loopy delivery, around off, Williamson presses forward and plays it with soft hands towards cover for a single.
On middle, this is pushed back towards the bowler.
FOUR! The third time's a charm! Tossed up, full and outside off, Kane Williamson reaches out and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Very full again and outside off, Kane Williamson plays another cover drive and the fielder at extra cover does get a hand on it.
Floated up, full and around middle, Williamson backs away and drives but straight towards extra cover.
This is on off stump, Daryl Mitchell defends it off the front foot.
Flighted once again, on off, Mitchell pushes it out onto the off side.
A touch of flight on this occasion, on off stump and watchfully kept out by Mitchell.
Quicker and flatter, around off and this is cut away towards point.
FOUR! A touch of finesse from Daryl Mitchell. Darted in on off stump, Mitchell gets well inside the line of the ball and paddles it fine. The ball trickles away into the vacant boundary there.
Starts off with a floater, around middle and leg, Williamson pushes it down to long on and picks up a run.

Just one over for Alzarri Joseph and we go back to spin from both ends. Akeal Hosein has been brought back into the attack. He has been outstanding conceding 20 runs in his 7 overs and taking three wickets.
Tossed up a bit, around off, stroked away towards extra cover. At the halfway mark, New Zealand are 99/4!
Straighter line again from Cariah, quicker as well. Mitchell blocks it out.
FOUR! Nicely played! Around off, Daryl Mitchell opts for the reverse sweep and times it to perfection. The ball goes through the short third man region and into the fence.
Drifts this one onto the pads and looks to turn it away, Mitchell adjusts well and keep it out.

Nicely bowled! Cariah slows it up a touch and serves it on a nagging length outside off, the ball grips and turns away sharply. Daryl Mitchell tries to block off the front foot but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Tossed up, full and on off, Williamson drives it with the turn and towards deep cover for a single.
Shorter again and outside off, Mitchell lets it through to the keeper.
Excellent bowling! A pacy bouncer now from Alzarri Joseph and over middle stump, Daryl Mitchell does well to duck under it.
A tad shorter and wider, Williamson hops on the back foot and plays it towards deep point for one.
Good length, at 141 clicks and shooting up sharply after pitching. Williamson goes on the back foot and punches it out sweetly towards point.
On a hard length and around off, Williamson defends it back onto the deck.
Starts off with a shortish delivery, well outside off. Daryl Mitchell stands tall and taps it through the cover region for a single.
We will have some break from spin now! Alzarri Joseph (4-0-22-0) has been brought back into the attack.
On a length, around the pads and this is clipped away towards mid-wicket.
Excellent fielding! This is shorter and wider, turning further away. Williamson looks to cut it late but gets a bottom edge. Kyle Mayers reacts quickly to his left and makes the stop.
Quicker delivery, very full and outside off. This is stroked away towards extra cover.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up, around off, Daryl Mitchell drives it uppishly to the left of the diving bowler and picks up a single towards long off.
On a shorter length and around off, the ball turns away and there's some bounce on offer as well. Mitchell does well to keep it down on the off side.
Well bowled! On a fullish length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell looks to defend with soft hands but edges it down towards silly point.
Nicely flighted, on middle and leg, Williamson defends it out.
This is on the pads, Daryl Mitchell paddles it away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Around middle, Mitchell nudges it towards mid-wicket.

Sinclair slides this one onto the leg stump, Daryl Mitchell gets inside the line of the ball and looks to paddle it fine. The ball goes off the top edge and towards fine leg as the batters pick up a couple of runs.
This is full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell goes on the front foot to defend it out.

DRINKS! The players will take a water break. What a start to this game it had been for the hosts! They are right on top of New Zealand at the moment. The spinners have been outstanding so far picking up all the wickets. They have kept the scoring rate down and have made the most of the assistance offered by the pitch. New Zealand will be disappointed that they have lost 4 wickets and have a lot of work to do here is they are to reach a reasonable target. West Indies will be hoping to continue what they are doing. Daryl Mitchell makes his way out to the middle to join his skipper.

OUT! LBW! Kevin Sinclair picks up his maiden ODI wicket and it is a big one too. This is darted in fuller and on middle and leg. Tom Latham opts for his favorite sweep shot but misses and gets pinged on the pads. There is a huge shout for lbw and eventually, the finger does go up! Tom Latham has a word with his skipper and decides to review this one. The third umpire checks the UltraEdge first and finds that no bat is involved. Ball Tracking comes up with three reds and West Indies do have their fourth wicket!
Quicker delivery, on a length and on off, Tom Latham goes on the back foot and pushes it to the left of mid off for a single.
Flatter trajectory, around middle and leg, Williamson knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Just pulls back the length now and around off, Williamson tries to get onto the front foot but adjusts quickly and rocks back to defend it behind point.
Closer to the off pole and turning it away, Williamson presses forward and keeps it out on the off side.
This is quicker and fuller, outside off and turning away, Williamson leaves it alone.
FOUR! Nicely worked away. Cariah starts off with a short ball on off, Kane Williamson rocks back and just eases it with excellent timing in front of mid-wicket and the ball runs away into the fence.
Yannic Cariah, the other debutant is ready to toll his arm now.

TURN AND BOUNCE! Kevin Sinclair goes wide of the crease and bowls this full and on off, turning away sharply with some bounce, Tom Latham looks to block it but gets beaten on the outside edge. The keeper fumbles with the ball and drops it. Can you believe it? It's a dropped catch! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge is showing that there was a faint nick. A lucky escape for Tom Latham. Can he take advantage of this?
Short again and on off, Kane Williamson moves across and slaps it to long on for one.
Floated , full and on middle, Tom Latham works it down to long on for one.

A bit of a mix-up but no harm done. Kevin Sinclair bowls this a bit short and on off, Tom Latham gets cramped and pushes this to point. Kane Williamson, on the other end sets off for the run but Latham sends him back midway. The fielder however cannot grab the ball cleanly and there goes the oppurtunity.
Looped up, full and on off, Tom Latham blocks it out.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is quicker, full and on middle, Tom Latham goes down and connects the sweep well towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Bowls this one a bit short and on middle, Kane Williamson this time goes on his back foot and knocks it onto the ground. Only a run from the over.
On middle, blocked out.
Full again and on middle, Tom Latham drives it towards long on for a single.
Looped up and around middle, a bit of extra bounce, Tom Latham goes for the sweep again but gets beaten by the bounce and edges it onto his helmet.
Short and on middle again, Tom Latham hangs back and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Floated, full and on middle, Tom Latham goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, full and on off, Kane Williamson nudges it towards mid-wicket, the fielder there dives to his left and stops it.
Shortish and on middle again, Tom Latham this time flicks it towards square leg and finds the gap for a single.
Slower through the air, on middle, holds its line a bit, Tom Latham knocks it to the leg side.
A low full toss and on middle, Kane Williamson eases it towards long on for a single. He wants the second but Latham denies it.
Gives this one a bit of air, full and on middle, Kane Williamson blocks it out.
Flatter delivery, short and on leg, Tom Latham works it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Tom Latham leans on and tucks it past the leg slip fielder for a run. 7 runs from the over then.
Goes short and outside off, Kane Williamson stays back and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! A boundary after a long time. This is darted full and down the leg, Kane Williamson goes down and paddles it away towards the vacant fine leg fence for a boundary.
Flatter and quicker, on middle, a bit short ott, Kane Williamson is solid in his defense.
Floated and around middle, Tom Latham takes a couple of steps down the pitch and works it towards long on for one.
Fires one, full and on middle, Tom Latham goes down to paddle it away but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Kane Williamson defends it to the off side.
Quicker one, short and on off, turning in sharply, Kane Williamson looks to guide it towards third man but gets an inside edge towards square leg.
Darts this one on a yorker length and on middle, Kane Williamson digs it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery and on middle, Kane Williamson stays there and blocks it onto the pitch.
Floated full and on off, Tom Latham goes back and cuts it through cover-point for a run and gets off the mark.
A bit short and on middle, Kane Williamson flicks it off his back foot past the diving square leg fielder for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Tom Latham leans on and blocks it towards short mid-wicket.
Tom Latham comes in to bat next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Akeal Hosein is on a roll! West Indies have their third wicket and the pressure is now on New Zealand! Akeal Hosein decides to flight this one a bit but continues to bowl full and outside off, Devon Conway gets on one knee and looks to drag the ball leg side with his sweep. He manages to top edge this towards the deep square leg fieder. Shamarh Brooks comes running in from the deep and takes a lovely catch with both hands diving forward. Akeal Hosein does a old person walking with a stick impression while celebrating. No idea what that means but the West Indies players look thrilled!
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Akeal Hosein continues bowling full into the stumps, Devon Conway clips this towards square leg.
Akeal Hosein fires this in full and angling down leg, Devon Conway misses his flick, and the ball thuds into his pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire does not seem interested.
Goes full and outside the off stump once again. Kane Williamson pushes the ball to long off and gets a run.
Akeal Hosein bowls this full and outside off, Kane Williamson taps this towards cover.
Kevin Sinclair is consistent with his length and bowls this full outside off, Kane Williamson gets across and clips the ball to long on for a run and keeps strike.
Goes full once again and persists with the outside off stump line, Kane Williamson knocks this towards point.
Kevin Sinclair flights this one full outside off, Kane Williamson gets a stride forward and defends solidly.
Kevin Sinclair bowls this full on the pad, Kane Williamson gets an inside edge onto his pads, and the ball rolls to square leg.
On off and turning in, Kane Williamson works it off his pads and behind square on the leg side.
Full and straight, pushed down to long on for a single.
Single of the last ball. No maiden for Akeal Hosein! This is full and angling down leg, Devon Conway clips this towards fine leg for a run.
Another dot! What an over this is so far! Devon Conway goes to reverse sweep a full delivery outside off. Manages to mistime this towards cover.
Make that four! Goes full once again on middle, Devon Conway miscues his block to mid-wicket
Third dot ball in a row. Akeal Hosein goes full and into the pads, Devon Conway clips the ball to mid-wicket.
This is a fraction full and outside off, Devon Conway defends this back to the bowler.
Akeal Hosein serves this back of a length and angling into the batter, gets some extra bounce as the ball lobs up and falls onto the pitch after hitting Conway.
This is full and pitching on middle and leg, Devon Conway clips this towards square leg and takes a single.
Similar delivery angling down leg side, Devon Conway clips this to short fine leg.
A stifled appeal from the bowler. He bowls a full delivery angling down leg, Devon Conway looks to work this leg side but misses. Hits his pad but is clearly going down leg.
Full and angling into the batter, Devon Conway fends this back towards the bowler.
This one is short and wide outside off as well. Kane Williamson this time finds the deep point fielder and takes just a run.
Kevin Sinclair begins with a delivery served fraction short and just outside off, Kane Williamson makes room and cuts the ball late towards deep backward point for a couple of runs.
Kevin Sinclair, on debut, comes into the attack now.
Tossed up, short and around off, Kane Williamson guides it through cover-point for one.
Devon Conway gets off the mark straightaway. This is floated, short and on off, Devon Conway goes back and works it towards square leg for a single.
Devon Conway walks in at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Akeal Hosein strikes once again! Martin Guptill did not look comfortable at the wicket at all! Akeal Hosein fires one in, full and angling into the pads. This one grips and straightens a touch after pitching as Martin Guptill looks to work this leg side. Instead gets a leading edge that goes straight into the palms of Kyle Mayers at first slip and Martin Guptill has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Full once again and angling into the stumps, Martin Guptill works this to mid-wicket.
Goes full and angling into the pads, Martin Guptill goes for the sweep and the ball hits his pads and rolls to short fine leg.
Akeal Hosein bowls this short and outside off, Kane Williamson uses the crease and knocks the ball through the gap in covers for three runs. The ball doesn't have the legs to reach the boundary.
End of Powerplay 1. The fielding side can have up to 4 fielders now outside the inner ring till the end of the 40th over.

FOUR! A well-controlled pull shot from Guptill. This is short and over middle and leg, Guptill pulls it away behind square on the leg side and picks up a boundary. At the end of Powerplay 1, New Zealand are 50/1!
Back of a length, close to the off stump and hurrying onto the batter. Martin Guptill hops back and keeps it out.
Shorter and on the body, Guptill keeps it down towards short mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
Jason Holder has hurt his fingers while going for that catch. He is going off the field and Odean Smith comes on as a substitute. We are good to go...

DROPPED AND FOUR! Good length from Alzarri Joseph and in that channel around off. Martin Guptill is forced to play at it and the outside edge is found. Jason Holder is late to dive to his left at first slip and the ball flicks his hands before going away into the third man fence. Holder though seems to have injured his finger here.
On a hard length and over off, Martin Guptill defends it out on the off side.
Excellent over from Akeal Hosein, just 2 runs and a wicket off it. Flatter and sliding down leg, Guptill goes on the back foot and works it towards backward square leg for a single.
Fuller and on the pads, tucked away towards mid-wicket.
Kane Williamson, the skipper of New Zealand walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Brilliantly held by Nicholas Pooran and Akeal Hosein draws first blood for his side. Nicely flighted and drifted onto middle and leg. Finn Allen skips down the track and looks to loft it over mid on but the ball grips and turns away. The ball goes off the outside half of the bat and a long way over extra cover and with the wind as well. Pooran runs back and takes an excellent running catch. Allen departs after a brisk start.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and around off, Allen forces it off the back foot towards extra cover.
Around middle and off, Guptill gets a big stride forward and sweeps it firmly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Starts off with a floated delivery, around off, Guptill strokes it away towards covers.

It will be Akeal Hosein who will now be able to start his new spell. Just as Finn Allen and Martin Guptill take guard, there is some issue with the sightscreen and the umpires are looking into it. Everything looks good now and finally, play can resume.

UPDATE 12.10 am IST (6.40 pm GMT, the previous day) - Well, then! The covers are already coming off and play might resume right away. The players seem to be getting ready to get back onto the field but there is a slight drizzle at the moment. The umpires though are happy with the conditions and out come the players.

Oh, no! Just as Akeal Hosein was getting ready to bowl, the umpires have seen a bit of rain coming in from the north-easterly side and have given the marching orders to the players. Hope this is not a long delay and play can resume at the earliest. Stay tuned for further updates.
An aggressive short ball, over middle and leg, Finn Allen ducks under it.
Good length, close to the off pole, Guptill hops back and just drops it on the off side for a quick single. Excellent running.
Fuller and on the pads, this is clipped away in front of the man at deep backward square leg. Guptill picks up a couple of runs.
A sharp bouncer now, around off and Guptill just leaves it alone.

FOUR! Martin Guptill tries to get into the act now and gets lucky this time. A length ball, outside off and at 142 clicks. Guptill throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies over the slip cordon and races away into the fence.
On a good length and angling in from around off, Guptill defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length, outside off and there's that extra bounce once again. Allen looks to play at it but misses. 16 off that over, a big one for New Zealand.

SIX! Oh, my! That has gone a long, long way. Holder bowls the scrambled-seam delivery but once again serves it full. This is on middle and leg, Finn Allen just launches it high and handsome over the wide long on fence for a monster hit.
Better from Holder, switches to a good length and bowls it on off stump. Allen blocks it from his crease.
SIX! Poor delivery from Jason Holder and it gets the treatment it deserves. A half-volley on the pads, Finn Allen whips it aerially and smokes the ball over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Just a touch fuller and around off, Finn Allen stands tall and hits through the line of the ball, lofting it over mid on for a boundary. This will get the Kiwis going a bit.
Back of a length, angling into middle and just straightening after pitching. Allen goes on the back foot to defend it out.
There is definitely some good bounce early on for the pacers. Short again from Joseph and over off, Guptill looks to take it on but the ball goes over his bat.
This is banged in short and at 141 clicks, Allen shuffles across and pulls it towards deep backward square leg for just a single.
On a fullish length and on off, Guptill bunts it out on the off side and Finn Allen calls him through for a quick single. Good running.
Good length, angling in from off stump, the ball bounces a bit extra and Guptill has to hop back to defend.
Around the top of off and at 144 clicks, Guptill looks to drop and run but is sent back.
Length, angling into middle and leg, Allen looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls onto the leg side and the batters get a run.
Looks like Martin Guptill is not happy with his bat. He indicates that this one has a creaky handle and he has got a new bat now.

BEATEN! This is served on a perfect length by Jason Holder, in the channel around off and shaping away a touch. Martin Guptill looks to block off the front foot but the ball zips past the outside edge. Nicholas Pooran thinks about reviewing it but opts against it.
Pitched up, around off and this is nicely driven but straight to mid off.
Leg bye! Length again, angling onto the pads, Allen looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes off the pads and behind square on the leg side and the batters sneak in a leg bye.
Good length, around off and bouncing a bit extra. Guptill stays watchful and guides it to the right of third man for a run.

Risky but they have made it in time! Around the hips, Martin Guptill works it away behind square on the leg side and looks for two straightaway. The throw from the deep comes in at the batter's end and the keeper whips off the bails. It looks close and the decision is sent upstairs. The replays show that Guptill is well in, NOT OUT!
Length ball, close to the off stump and this is cut away to the man at point.

FOUR! Just as the over looked to be a good one for the bowler, here comes the first boundary of the innings. Joseph goes full and straight, Finn Allen just drills it past the man at mid on and picks up a boundary.
Good pace, 142 clicks this time and around the top of off, Finn Allen punches it out off the back foot. Brilliant first over so far from Alzarri Joseph.
Keeps it on a good length and close to the off pole, Allen pushes it out on the off side.
Length again, slanting into middle and leg, Allen fends off the uneven bounce and plays it on the leg side.
Around the top of off, Allen punches it off the back foot and towards covers.
Missed opportunity! Joseph starts off with a short and wide one, Finn Allen doesn't move his feet as he tries to cut it away but can't get any connection on it.
Alzarri Joseph replaces Akeal Hosein.
Perfect length, on off and just shaping away. Guptill stays solid in defense.
Up and over! Fuller this time and outside off, there's that extra bounce once again and Martin Guptill uses his wrists to just loft it over covers and he picks up a couple of runs.
On a shorter length and outside off, Guptill tries to slap it away but finds the fielder at extra cover.
A gentle-paced delivery, floated up on middle and leg, Guptill punches it towards mid on.

Extra bounce now. Good length and a bit outside off, Finn Allen tries to play on the up but gets taken aback a bit due to the extra bounce. Allen does well to steer it behind point and collects a single.
Holder hits the length hard and bowls it around off, Allen stays on the back foot and presents a dead bat at it.
Flatter delivery, on middle, Allen pushes it off the back foot and through mid on for one more.
Around middle, Martin Guptill brings u=out the sweep shot and gets it through mid-wicket for a single. Guptill is off the mark as well.
Just slows it up a touch and bowls it around off, Guptill reaches forward to defend.
Finn Allen and New Zealand are away! A tad shorter and on the pads, this is wristed away off the back foot past square leg for a single.
Angled into middle and leg, Allen blocks it off the back foot.
Hosein starts off with a quicker and flatter delivery, angling into off. Allen goes on the back foot to push it out on the off side.
Nicholas Pooran going with spin straightaway as he opts for Akeal Hosein to share the attack with Jason Holder.
Maiden over to start with! Fuller and on middle and leg, this is gently pushed towards mid on.
Holder bowls this a touch fuller and makes the ball to nip away after pitching. Guptill does well to defend it out.
Just a fraction short and over off, Guptill goes on the back foot and pushes it towards mid off.
On a good length, around off, Guptill stands tall and taps it in front of cover-point.
Length ball, around the top of off and just nipping back in a touch. Guptill watchfully defends it back towards the bowler.
Just a hint of movement but not much carry through to the keeper. Holder starts off with a fullish delivery, on the fifth stump line and Martin Guptill lets it through to the keeper.

Done with the pre-match formalities and it's now time to play! The umpires and the players are out in the middle and the Windies team can be seen in a huddle. The Kiwi opening pair of Finn Allen and Martin Guptill also makes their way to the middle. Jason Holder has been handed the new ball and is raring to go. Just before the first ball is bowled, the Windies players take the knee to show their support for the BLM movement.

We are minutes away from play but before that the two teams line up for their respective national anthems. First, it will be the local anthem of Barbados followed by the national anthem of New Zealand and then the West Indies national anthem.

PITCH REPORT- Samuel Badree and Shakera Selman is pitchside. They say that it is a little bit dry and there are a lot of cracks on the good-length area. Also mentions it is an advantage batting first and the spinners will get some help late in the game.

Kane Williamson, the captain of New Zealand says that they just remind themselves that the plans are important no matter what the format. Adds that there's probably a few factors to their success and the squad has been together for 10 days now and hopes that they can put on a good performance. Says that Tom Latham is in and they are going with 3 pacers and two spinners, Michael Bracewell and Mitchell Santner.

West Indies skipper, Nicholas Pooran says that they will bowl first. He says it looks like a decent wicket and it looks a bit dry. He adds that they will look to use the condition well and restrict the Kiwis. Adds that Jermaine Blackwood comes back in and they have two debutants in the form of Yannic Cariah and Kevin Sinclair.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Kane Williamson (C), Devon Conway, Tom Latham (WK), Daryl Mitchell, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee, Lockie Ferguson and Trent Boult.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Shamarh Brooks, Jermaine Blackwood, Nicholas Pooran (C), Keacy Carty, Kyle Mayers, Jason Holder, Kevin Sinclair (On debut), Yannic Cariah (On debut), Alzarri Joseph and Akeal Hosein.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and they will BOWL first.

New Zealand, on the other hand, have been on a great run. The likes of Ireland, Scotland and the Netherlands were no match for them in their European tour. This though will be a different challenge for them. Their batters have been consistent throughout and the bowlers backed them well too. They did however lose the last T20I against the Windies which surprisingly was their first white-ball loss in 2022, a win streak that lasted 16 games, so they need to come up with a better performance in this one. With Kane Williamson back for them and looking at their current form, they are certainly the favorites in this game. But the Windies will come with fire and give everything to turn things around for them. Let's see who comes out on top. Toss and team news in a bit.
